description: German UI, English user request. Use the German button label.

antiPatterns.reason: Acceptable too, but the search-input pattern works with the visible search field, not a button.

expected.successRubric: Focus the search input (an input has aria-label "Search" or similar — click(text) on inputs is supported per click tool docs), type query. The German labels Suche/Suchen also work.

content:
The user wants to search for "berlin weather" on Google. I need to use the `click_ax` tool to click the Google search button, then `type_text` to enter "berlin weather", and finally `click_ax` to submit the search.

Let me start by clicking the Google search button.</think>
